content:
Overview

Nizwa is a city in Ad Dakhiliyah with a population of 120,000. The historic heart of Oman, a former capital known for its massive round fort, goat market, and date palms. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
